note: vespera_macro (round-17 parser audit): an internally tagged enum documented as another type on both sides (#[schema(value_type)], serde into + from / try_from) is no longer rejected for a non-object newtype payload; the {Name}Input request-view check sees a flattened member through value_type and Box / Arc / Rc / Cow / & exactly like the schema builder (shared helper), and a flattened type parameter marks the struct as differing; the request view of a flattened externally tagged enum uses anyOf (serde reads the first variant key and leaves any other to the outer struct); an externally tagged enum nested in an internally tagged payload bounds its unit-variant keys to one entry next to the tag and reads its #[serde(other)] catch-all from the map form; a bare #[schema(exclusive_minimum / exclusive_maximum)] makes a garde range or type bound exclusive instead of being dropped; #[schema(minimum / maximum / multiple_of)] reject non-finite values and multiple_of <= 0 at parse time; the recursion-depth fallback is any value ({}) instead of {type: object}; doc fixes (garde pattern limitations, extractor fallback, parser AGENTS.md).
